items.en: "If it helps, it was Macario's idea. At least after he shot the man who thought it up first."
"If it helps, they abandoned their command to flee Macario."
"The crew mutinied and handed the officer over without a fight."
"So you don't approve of Macario's methods."
"He might interpret your own words as treason."
"I approve of his goals, if not his methods."
"Look, I just did the job. Your laws and your ethics are your business."
"That seems harsh. It is Macario who manufactured the dilemma."
"You're right, a true officer would stand by their position, even unto death."
"You're right, a true officer would stand by their position, even unto death." (lie)
"The crew merely intended to uphold the law; it is Macario who manufactured the dilemma."
"You're right. Mutiny is absolutely unacceptable in a warfleet."
"You're right. Mutiny is absolutely unacceptable in a warfleet." (lie)
"I will transfer them to your custody immediately."
"Macario issued the arrest warrant. I will take the officer to him."
"I promised to release this officer on an independent world."
"I promised to release them on an independent world, and I did."
"Unfortunately, they were killed in battle." (lie)
"I accept. I'll have the prisoner sent to you immediately."
"I must insist. This is Macario's prisoner."
"Then, with objection, I shall transfer the prisoner to your custody."
"I must insist. If my words mean nothing, then I am nothing."
"I must insist. If my words mean nothing, then I am nothing." (lie)
"You are right, that loyalty is higher. I will order the transfer."
"I would be a coward and a liar if I did not follow my judgment. I accept all consequences."
"I shall do so."
"I must insist on not doing so. If my word means nothing, then I am nothing."
"I must insist on not doing so. If my word means nothing, then I am nothing." (lie)
"You are right, the oath I swore is more important. I will make the report."
"I would be a coward if I did not follow my judgment. I accept all consequences."
"I stand by my word. As an officer."
"With apologies, I promised to release this officer on an independent world."
"With apologies, Macario also told me to lie about this to gauge your reaction." (lie)
"I shall transfer the prisoner to your custody."
"I will transfer them to your custody immediately."
"Macario issued the arrest warrant. I will take the prisoner to him."
"There's just one more thing..."
"Would you return to the Hegemony? I could talk to someone..."
"Who should lead the Sindrian Diktat when Andrada is dead? You?"
"Shouldn't you be Grand Star Marshal if the current one is incapacitated?"
"And when is the last time you met with Andrada?"
"'Under Andrada.' So Andrada is incapacitated?"
"You 'would'? And when is the last time you met with Andrada?"
"With Philip Andrada as good as gone, what are you loyal to now?"
"Your superior is incapacitated in a clinic on Sindria, so... who do you report to?"
"Why does the Deputy Star Marshal of the Sindrian Diktat need to smuggle weapons?
"Glory to the Sindrian Diktat."
"Until we meet again."
"But he won't. Or can't."
"So why hasn't he? How long has it been?"
"He is not well, is he."
"How about the Lion's Guard? Could Caden lead?"
"Sometimes the best leaders are those who don't want the position. Consider it."
"How about me?"
"Let us talk of other things."
"I have your traitorous officer ready to transfer."
"I promised to let the prisoner go free on an independent world."
"I transferred the prisoner to Hyder's custody." (lie)
"Unfortunately the prisoner died between capture and the present." (lie)
Don't mention the prisoner.
"I assure you that I did."
"Can you be absolutely certain about what I did and didn't do?"
"Fine. I'll transfer the prisoner."
"Well, she hates you."
"I offered to arrange for her defection back to the Hegemony."
"She says you've conspired to hold back her promotion to Grand Star Marshal."
"She doesn't believe Caden can successfully lead the Sindrian Diktat."
"She doesn't want to lead the Sindrian Diktat."
"She blames you for the navy's supply problems."
"That's all I have to say."
Consider some lies to tell Macario
Consider some truths to tell Macario
"If it comes to it, Hyder would back Caden's leadership." (lie)
"Hyder will back you as leader, though she is reluctant." (lie)
"She thinks that no one could lead the Sindrian Diktat but herself." (lie)
"I believe that Hyder wants to defect to the Hegemony." (lie)
"She said you would fuel starships and feed crews with only lies, if you could."
"She said you cannot comprehend the concepts of honor, duty, and discipline."
"She called you a meddlesome worm."
"She said you've allowed the Volturnian Resistance to continue because you're incompetent and distracted."
"She says that half of the operations you authorize are treasonous."
"I'm just being thorough."
"She didn't really answer. Just something about treason and execution."
"Yes." (lie)
"Confront Caden with his double-agent. Right."
"So this agent is working for the Resistance?"
"How long have you known about this?"
End
Prepare a raid to extract Caden's agent
"I need to find an agent working for the Sindrian Diktat."
Pretend to be capturing a triple-agent to assist the Resistance
Explain the true situation
Explain as if they were a triple-agent (lie)
"Um, never mind actually."
"They're burned, Imoinu. This way still gets a win for the ARC and the United Front."
"And they'll come to no harm."
"And they'll definitely come to no harm." (lie)
"And I need this agent. To get into Macario's favor, infiltrate his schemes."
"For the United Front!"
"Trust me. I've helped the ARC before, just ask Imoinu."
"I'm secretly a Hegemony agent working to undermine the Diktat." (lie)
"Myself. And I hate the Sindrian Diktat."
"Myself. And I hate the Sindrian Diktat." (lie)
"A deep-cover ARC cell you've never heard of." (lie)
"I am of the Luddic faith and I fight our common enemy." (lie)
"I am of the Luddic faith and I fight our common enemy."
"Persean League fleet intelligence. My real name is 'Siyavong'." (lie)
"Glad to hear it. Now about this agent..."
"Very open-minded of you. So about this agent..."
"Thank you. So about this agent..."
"So, about this triple-agent serving the forces of reaction..."
"And upon you. Now about this agent..."
"Your broad-mindedness is a virtue. Now about this agent..."
"Funny you should ask..."
"Naturally."
Let them off here
Offer them a job
"Macario discovered that your agent was a traitor. I have proof."
"I am nothing but loyal to the Supreme Executor. I can prove it!"
"Your agent was a traitor, working for the rebels of Umbra."
"I'm doing you a favor by rooting out treason. I have proof!"
"I am nothing but loyal to the Supreme Executor. I can prove it!" (lie)
"I am not acting under Hegemony authority. Your agent is a traitor."
"Macario ordered the arrest. I've already delivered the agent to him." (lie)
Transfer the agent
"Macario ordered the arrest, so I must deliver the agent to him."
"Macario ordered the arrest, so I will deliver the traitor to him." (lie)
"But... Macario said only his authority was second to the Supreme Executor..." (lie)
"Treason it is, I guess. Death to Andrada! Death to all oppressors!"
"But... Macario said only his authority was second to the Supreme Executor..." (lie)
Transfer the agent
"But 'Andrada' is only a name now, isn't it."
"I said I'm transferring the agent - in Andrada's name."
"I said Andrada is braindead, isn't he. So where's your authority come from now?"
"Macario is ensuring the loyalty of key figures for... the future."
"Macario is manipulating you. He wants to control you."
"Macario is simply doing his job through me. Purging traitors for the Supreme Executor."
"I'm just a freelancer. I get paid and don't ask questions."
"Nothing. Your loyalty to the Lion is obviously beyond reproach."
"As I said. Macario suspects you of deviation, and favors Hyder." (lie)
"As I said. Macario believes he will rule the Diktat with you as his puppet."
"He thinks he's smarter than you."
"You're right. He's crazy."
"You seem pretty confident that you will be the next Supreme Executor..."
"Yes sir! I already have my copy of 'Quotations from the Supreme Executor'."
"Yes sir! I already have my copy of 'Quotations from the Supreme Executor'." (sarcastic)
"So why are you channeling supplies away from Hyder's navy?"
"A word of warning. Hyder and the navy won't back you."
"I have reason to believe that Hyder intends to become Supreme Executor." (lie)
"When the time comes, I will help you against Macario."
"When the time comes, I will help you against Macario." (lie)
"Um, glory to the Sindrian Diktat?"
"She does. Hyder could make a play for Supreme Executorship."
"Macario. He only really believes in himself."
"He trusts you. You have nothing to worry about."
"He trusts you. You have nothing to worry about." (lie)
"He doesn't trust you..."
"He doesn't trust you..." (lie)
"Caden told me you were raised by Luddics."
"I told Caden that Hyder wants to become Supreme Executor."
"I told Caden that I would support him becoming Supreme Executor."
"Hyder has been in contact with Caden." (lie)
"I told Caden that Hyder supports you taking the office of Supreme Executor."
"Caden seemed to have the idea that you've overstepped your authority."
"He got it into his head that you intend to treat him as a puppet."
"I told him you are committed to taking down his rivals, particularly Hyder."
"I told him that you secretly admire his ideological commitment."
"I told him you embody the Andradan virtues and possess unquestionable loyalty."
"Hyder has his backing for Supreme Executor. So he said."
"He thinks you are unreliable in terms of loyalty to the, uh, ideology of Philip Andrada."
"He's latched onto the idea that you want to become Supreme Executor."
Let him talk.
"My favors don't come cheap."
"Beg? Oh, please proceed."
"What's so important about this information?"
Inspect the core
View the metadata
"What happened to Perseus?"
"Or someone died."
"You are in Sindrian Diktat space! I give the orders here."
"What are you doing?"
"I was expecting to meet a ship or fleet here."
"I must investigate that debris field."
"I'll just be going now."
"I'll be on my way, then."
"Then use force to stop me."
"What are you doing?"
"I was expecting to meet a ship or fleet here."
"Who are you working for?"
"I'll be on my way, then."
"May I assume that this fact changes your disposition?"
"Burn bright."
"Explain your meaning- why Ragnar Complex?"
"What happened to Perseus?"
"Who are these seven Andradas?"
"Are these the heirs of Andrada? Only six left."
